text:
Which statement about alpha, beta and gamma emissions is correct?
A
Alpha-particles are lighter than beta-particles.
B
Beta-particles are not deflected by magnetic fields.
C
Gamma rays are more penetrating than alpha-particles and beta-particles.
D
Gamma rays are more ionising than alpha-particles and beta-particles.

options.label: B
options.text: Beta-particles are not deflected by magnetic fields.

options.label: C
options.text: Gamma rays are more penetrating than alpha-particles and beta-particles.

options.label: D
options.text: Gamma rays are more ionising than alpha-particles and beta-particles.
